# Viral Hook Analysis

## Procedure
Classify promise, curiosity, conflict, surprise; generate multiple unique options; avoid misleading bait; define a hook retention or viewed-vs-swiped metric when genuinely available.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
